summary: First full test iteration for Sri Bhavatarini Ashrama MVP. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases passed (public routes, auth, events CRUD, protected lists, gallery upload/serve/delete). Frontend: all navigation tabs, seeded events (3), contact form submission with success toast, admin login/logout, all 4 admin tabs (Events, Gallery, Messages, Donations) working. Message from contact form visible in admin Messages tab (E2E flow verified). Donations 503 and email_sent=false correctly treated as expected behavior.

issues: Uses browser default date picker (input type=date) instead of shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component. Consider replacing for consistent UX.

action_items: Optional: Replace browser default date picker with shadcn DatePicker in AdminDashboard Add Event form for design consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~437 lines - still within limits but consider splitting into routers (auth, events, gallery, donations, contact) as it grows.
Contact form endpoint does not rate-limit; publicly writeable to db.messages could be abused. Consider basic rate limiting or captcha.
get_current_admin uses secure=True, samesite=none cookies which requires HTTPS (fine in prod); local dev over http will not persist cookie. Bearer token fallback covers this.
Image upload has no size/type validation on server (MIME_TYPES only maps extension). Consider max file size guard and content-type allowlist to prevent abuse.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 3 sample events on startup (verified). Contact form test created a message TEST_User which appears in admin Messages tab.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core flows pass. Razorpay + Resend intentionally unconfigured (donations return 503, email_sent=false is expected). If keys are added later, add donation order/verify and email delivery test coverage. Gallery upload uses Emergent object storage — a real 1x1 PNG upload was verified end-to-end via GET /api/gallery/{id}/image.
